"THE PR PARTY"
Day: 30   Wednesday 10-30-24

Warm Up: Kick the door down as you enter the weight room. Chili so hot your nickname is "Dragon Breath"

1. BACK SQUAT
5 reps @ 55%, 3 @ 65%, 2 @ 75%, 1 @ 85%, 93%, 100%
2 to 2½ min rest between these ramp up sets
1 rep @ 105%, 108%, 110%, 112%...
2½ to 3 min rest between these sets
Keep climbing 2-3% each set if it is there to get.

Cardio
Planned Day Off!!

Recovery
Spaghetti and Meatballs
Favorite Halloween Candy
Big Sleep
